rules: No item in this file is approved evidence.
Popular or historiographic labels must not replace primary analytical classifications.
Corrections and errata must be attached before review.
Dataset records require provenance and license checks before publication layers use them.

candidates.title: Reconstructing the Life History of Double Perforated Ivory Beads…
candidates.decomposition_pressure: Separates production residue from intentional coloration; supports a physical-modification to semantic-content inference ladder.

candidates.title: Performing Power and Transitional Space…
candidates.decomposition_pressure: Candidate for sensory architecture and ritual-space dimensions; model interpretation must remain subordinate to archaeological observation.

candidates.title: Non-normative 17th-century burial at Pień
candidates.decomposition_pressure: Actions and material configuration can be coded; 'vampire' remains a historiographic/popular label unless primary sources justify a period emic term.

candidates.title: Behavioral Modernity, Neanderthals and Homo sapiens: a Case for Concept Retirement
candidates.decomposition_pressure: Supports retiring umbrella 'behavioral modernity' labels in favor of observable component constructs.

candidates.title: Late Bronze Age Central European mortuary practices and population relationships
candidates.decomposition_pressure: Strong discriminator between ancestry, cultural affiliation, diffusion and local innovation mechanisms.

candidates.title: Ancient DNA, tomb architecture and kinship
candidates.decomposition_pressure: Requires separate biological-kinship and socially-constructed-kinship dimensions; correction/erratum must be linked before review.

candidates.title: Ajvide co-burials and biological relatedness
candidates.decomposition_pressure: Adds biological-relatedness vs mortuary-organization relation without inferring ancestor worship.

candidates.title: OBIMD: Multi-modal Dataset for Contextual Interpretation of Oracle Bone Inscriptions
candidates.decomposition_pressure: Infrastructure source for divination, oracle practice, text and ritual context; individual religious meanings remain claim-level questions.

candidates.title: NEENA isotopic dataset
candidates.decomposition_pressure: Contextual substrate for distinguishing mobility/population movement from cultural transmission around sites and mortuary practices.

candidates.title: Chleby Neolithic enclosure
candidates.decomposition_pressure: Keep field discovery separate from peer-reviewed evidence; ritual-center and astronomical-function claims remain interpretations.

requested_model_changes: Replace behavioral-modernity umbrella labels with observable constructs.
Add ancestry vs cultural affiliation vs diffusion vs local innovation mechanism discriminator.
Separate biological kinship from social kinship.
Store popular labels such as vampire burial as aliases, not primary classifications.
Add dataset-source licensing and provenance review.
Use material-signification ladder: physical modification -> recurrent pattern -> conventionalized practice -> information-bearing system? -> semantic content?
